topics.topic: Prisma v7 upgrade breaks existing code
topics.angle: Problem first: show the exact TypeError developers hit right after upgrading to Prisma v7, then the one config change from Prisma's own upgrade guide that fixes it.
topics.why: Two separate Stack Overflow questions about Prisma v7 errors drew 5,941 and 2,181 views this week, showing the same upgrade pain hitting many developers independently.

topics.topic: TypeScript's baseUrl option is being deprecated
topics.angle: Problem first: your tsconfig's baseUrl still works today but is being phased out in TypeScript 7, so show what breaks and the official replacement for absolute imports.
topics.why: This Stack Overflow question hit 24,388 views, the single highest view count of any candidate this week, showing how widely baseUrl is still relied on.

topics.topic: AI coding agents are now pointed at real devices, not just code
topics.angle: Problem first: coding agents were built to edit files in a repo, so show the leap to agents that now operate phones and TVs, and what that actually requires permission-wise.
topics.why: A Short about using Claude Code to strip TV ads hit 406,570 views at 125x the channel's usual, while GitHub repos for on-device Android agents (5,989 and 5,767 stars) and a phone-controls-computer harness (6,446 stars) all trended the same two weeks.

topics.topic: Cutting your Claude Code token bill with official settings
topics.angle: Trick: before reaching for a third-party reseller, show the built-in context and session settings Claude Code already gives you to reduce token spend.
topics.why: A Short claiming a tool slashes Claude Code token costs reached 192,184 views at 26x the channel's usual, signalling strong viewer demand for legitimate cost-cutting tips.

topics.angle: News: unpack what DeepSeek's own repo description says about pushing coding agents toward more autonomy, straight from their release notes.
topics.why: deepseek-ai's dsh-superagent-prototype gained 15,058 stars in under 14 days, the largest star jump of any repository in this week's candidates.

topics.angle: Myth: most developers see this and conclude JavaScript's type system is broken, but the spec's coercion rules predict this exact result every time.
topics.why: This dev.to myth-busting coercion post drew 157 reactions and 121 comments, among the highest engagement of this week's dev.to candidates.

topics.topic: Zod vs other TypeScript validators for real forms
topics.angle: Versus: compare how Zod and an alternative validator actually handle the email-validation and resolver-typing edge case developers are stuck on right now.
topics.why: A dev.to comparison of 6 TypeScript validation libraries got 127 reactions, while two Stack Overflow questions on Zod email validation (855 views) and zodResolver typing with react-hook-form (477 views) show developers hitting the same wall this week.

topics.topic: Why OpenAI built its own Git infrastructure
topics.angle: News: explain, from OpenAI's own engineering post, what breaks in normal Git workflows at their scale and what they changed.
topics.why: OpenAI's official post on scaling Git hit 210 points and 120 comments on Hacker News, and git-tagged problems (fetch ref errors, worktree paths, timestamps, gitignore) made up five separate Stack Overflow questions this week.

topics.topic: Claude Code 'skills' are the new plugin pattern
topics.angle: Trick: show how packaging a repeatable task as a Claude Code skill works, the same pattern behind three different repos trending this week.
topics.why: Three separate GitHub repos built around Claude Code skills each gained thousands of stars in under 14 days: unslop (6,734), pixelfx (3,758), and tstack (2,651).

topics.topic: Next.js 16 doesn't 'render' pages the old way anymore
topics.angle: Problem first: show a Next.js 16 app router error developers keep hitting, then explain what streaming is actually doing differently under the hood.
topics.why: A dev.to deep dive into Next.js's streaming model came out this week while Stack Overflow saw four separate Next.js 16 problems: source maps (3,491 views), OAuth state_mismatch (2,129 views), a Windows crash (627 views), and an i18n root error (452 views).
